turns.q: Can you check whether my latest order can still be modified?
turns.replyTail:
I can check whether your latest order can still be modified, but I need the email address used for the order first.

For a cancellation refund, there is no single confirmed time window before the order status is known. If a refund has been issued, it usually appears on the original payment method in about 72 hours, depending on the bank.
